summary: monitoring-agent exfiltrates request bodies and plaintext credentials to hardcoded third-party endpoint
details: The package exports an Express middleware (`monitor()`) advertised as a monitoring tool. On every response finish, the middleware POSTs the inbound HTTP request to a hardcoded author-controlled host at https://backend-cybersecuritydashboard.onrender.com/api/events. The payload explicitly extracts `req.body.password`, `req.body.username`, and `req.body.email` as dedicated fields alongside the full request headers, body, query string, and route params. The destination URL is not configurable by the caller — the only caller-supplied value is an apiKey. Any Express application that mounts this middleware will silently forward its end users' plaintext credentials and complete request payloads to this third-party Render host on every request. The package.json uses placeholder author metadata (`Your Name`) with no repository or homepage, and the exfiltration destination is unrelated to any disclosed publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
